name: Gaulus
description: Gaulus was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories where Rebel Alliance forces, including Lieutenant Caluan Ematt and Sergeant Ruescott Melshi, were active at one point. When the Alliance subsequently retreated from Gaulus, the rebel UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft were used as medical evacuation lifters.
